sourceCopy.name: Markdown Table Generator
sourceCopy.title: Markdown Table Generator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Build Markdown tables online. Edit cells, align columns, import CSV or TSV, escape pipes, and copy the finished Markdown.
sourceCopy.intro: Create a Markdown table in a small editable grid. Import comma-separated, semicolon-separated, or tab-separated text, choose column alignment, and copy plain Markdown with pipes safely escaped.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I make a Markdown table?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Enter a header row and data rows, choose each column alignment, then copy the generated Markdown. Pipes are escaped and uneven imported rows are padded.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Your table is processed in this browser tab. Import, edits, and generated Markdown are not sent to a server or saved automatically.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I import CSV or TSV?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Paste comma-separated, semicolon-separated, or tab-separated values, then import them into the editable grid. Quoted CSV fields and quoted separators are supported.

additionalFaqs.question: How are pipes and line breaks handled?
additionalFaqs.answer:
A pipe inside a cell is escaped so it does not split the Markdown table. Backslashes are escaped too, and cell line breaks are represented with
.
